name: sealed-lattice-workspace
description: Verification helpers for post-quantum threshold voting artifacts in Node and browsers.
author: Piotr Piech <piotr@piech.dev>

scripts.api:report: pnpm run build && pnpm exec api-extractor run --local --config packages/sdk/api-extractor.json
scripts.check:static: pnpm run lint && pnpm run tsc && pnpm exec depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs packages/*/src && pnpm run api:check && pnpm exec tsx ./tools/ci/verify-public-package-policy.ts && pnpm exec tsx ./tools/ci/verify-test-vectors.ts && pnpm exec knip
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check -p sealed-lattice-kernel && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run check:static && pnpm run check:rust
scripts.test:node:fast: pnpm run build && pnpm exec tsx ./tools/ci/run-node-tests.ts --only fast
scripts.test:node:protocol: pnpm run build && pnpm exec tsx ./tools/ci/run-node-tests.ts --only protocol
scripts.test:node:kernel: pnpm run build && pnpm exec tsx ./tools/ci/run-node-tests.ts --only kernel
scripts.test:node: pnpm run build && pnpm exec tsx ./tools/ci/run-node-tests.ts
scripts.test:browser: pnpm run build && pnpm exec vitest --project browser-desktop --project browser-mobile --run
scripts.test:encrypted-aggregate-bridge: pnpm run build && pnpm exec tsx ./tools/ci/run-encrypted-aggregate-bridge-matrix.ts
scripts.test:encrypted-aggregate-bridge:represen: pnpm run build && pnpm exec tsx ./tools/ci/run-encrypted-aggregate-bridge-matrix.ts --representative
scripts.test: pnpm run test:node && pnpm run test:browser
scripts.coverage:node: pnpm run build && pnpm exec vitest --project node --run --coverage
scripts.coverage:badge: pnpm run coverage:node && pnpm exec tsx ./tools/generate-coverage-badge.ts
scripts.docs:api: pnpm run build && pnpm exec del-cli docs/src/content/docs/api/reference && pnpm exec tsx ./node_modules/typedoc/bin/typedoc --options typedoc.config.mjs && pnpm exec tsx ./docs/typedoc/postprocess-site-docs.ts
scripts.docs:dev: pnpm run docs:api && pnpm exec astro dev --root docs
scripts.docs:build: pnpm run docs:api && pnpm exec del-cli docs/dist && pnpm exec astro build --root docs --silent
scripts.docs:preview: pnpm run docs:build && pnpm exec astro preview --root docs
scripts.verify:docs: pnpm run docs:build && pnpm exec tsx ./docs/typedoc/verify-docs.ts && pnpm exec lhci autorun --config=./lighthouserc.cjs
scripts.smoke:pack:npm: pnpm --filter sealed-lattice run build && pnpm exec tsx ./tools/ci/verify-packed-package.ts --package-manager npm
